# AI With Ease

> AI With Ease helps small businesses, growing teams, and busy professionals put AI to work without losing the human element, through AI Tool Assessments, individualised coaching, and team workshops.

## Pages

- [Home](https://aiwithease.co.za/): Overview of AI With Ease and what we offer.
- [AI Tools Assessment](https://aiwithease.co.za/assessment): A roadmap identifying the AI tools best suited to your business and how to use them effectively.
- [Individualised Coaching](https://aiwithease.co.za/coaching): One-on-one, once-off or ongoing sessions to help put your AI roadmap into action.
- [Team Workshops](https://aiwithease.co.za/workshops): Hands-on, tailored group training workshops delivered online or in-person in Cape Town, giving teams practical confidence with AI tools.
- [Contact](https://aiwithease.co.za/contact): Contact form, email, and location details.
